title: UserProfileGranularAccessDTO
description: Data Transfer Object for creating or updating a user profile with granular access controls.

example.name: Contact Center Admin Profile
example.description: This profile should be applied only to contact center admins.

organizationId.description: ID of the contact center organization. This field is required for all bulk save operations.

id.description: ID of this contact center resource. It should not be specified when creating a new resource. However, it is mandatory when updating a resource.

version.description: The version of this resource. For a newly created resource, it will be 0 unless specified otherwise.

name.description: The name of the user profile.

description.description: An optional description of the profile.
description.example: This profile should be applied only to contact center admins.

profileType.description:
The type determines the privileges applicable for a profile.

It can take one of these values:

STANDARD_AGENT — Has access to Agent Desktop[m_agent_desktop] module.

PREMIUM_AGENT — Has access to Agent Desktop[m_agent_desktop] and Multimedia[m_multimedia] module.

SUPERVISOR — Has access to all modules except to manage tenants in the Provisioning[m_provisioning] module.

ADMINISTRATOR — Has access to all modules.

ADMINISTRATOR_ONLY — Has access to Provisioning[m_provisioning], Real Time Reports[m_real_time_reports], Call Recording[m_call_recording], IMI Digital Channels[m_imi_digital_channels], and Routing Strategy[m_routing_strategy] modules.

It is required only during a create operation. 

The profile type cannot be changed for an existing user profile.

active.description: Specify whether the User profile is active or not.

permissionAccessLevel.description:
This can be used to allow users of this profile access to specific or all the Webex Contact Center permissions.

It can take one of these values:

ALL — A contact center user with this profile can access all Contact Center permissions.

SPECIFIC — A contact center user with this profile can access only specific permissions.

resourceAccessLevel.description:
This can be used to allow users of this profile access to specific or all the Webex Contact Center resources.

It can take one of these values:

ALL — A contact center user with this profile can access all Contact Center resources.

SPECIFIC — A contact center user with this profile can access only specific resources.

permissions.description:
Specifies the permissions(s) a user of this profile has access to.

It should be chosen when permission access is SPECIFIC.

Please specify all the following permissions and their respective access type.

editableFolderIds.description: Indicates the id(s) of the reporting folders a user of this profile has read and write access to.

viewableFolderIds.description: Indicates the id(s) of the reporting folders a user of this profile has read access to.

nonViewableFolderIds.description: Indicates the id(s) of the restricted reporting folders for a user of this profile.

systemDefault.description: Indicates whether the created resource is system created or not

defaultResourceCollectionId.description: Specifies the default resource collection for this profile

resourceCollections.description:
Specifies the resource collection(s) a user of this profile has access to.

resource collection(s) needs to be specified when resourceAccessLevel is SPECIFIC

createdTime.description: This is the created time of the entity.

lastUpdatedTime.description: This is the updated time of the entity.
